units_convention.dG_ref_definition: dG_eff_ref_kj_mol describes the effective aggregation rate k_eff(T_ref) = k_agg(T_ref) * f_U(T_ref) in fraction/hour via Eyring equation k_eff(T_ref) = (kB*T_ref/h)*3600*exp(-dG_eff_ref/(R*T_ref)). Intrinsic step barrier is dG_agg_ref = dG_eff_ref + R*T_ref*ln(f_U(T_ref)).

dG_eff_ref_kj_mol.description: Effective Eyring free energy barrier at T_ref=278.15K (5C) for k_eff = k_agg * f_U in fraction/hour (121.066 kJ/mol gives 3.8415e-7 fraction/h = 0.0281% HMW/month)

dG_agg_ref_kj_mol.description: Intrinsic Eyring free energy barrier at T_ref=278.15K (5C) for U -> HMW step k_agg(T_ref) in fraction/hour (linked via dG_eff_ref + R*T_ref*ln(f_U_ref))

dH_agg_ref_kj_mol.description: Intrinsic transition-state activation enthalpy for U -> HMW aggregation step at T_ref=278.15K (implies nominal dS_agg_ref = -241.19 J/mol/K at dG_agg_ref = 105.09 kJ/mol; noted for SME review in LIMITATIONS.md, no gate)

dCp_agg_kj_mol_k.description: Activation heat capacity change for aggregation step (default 0.0; optional bounded non-zero)

ku_ref_5c.description: Equilibrium constant K_u(5C) for aggregation-competent partially unfolded state U

dH_u_kj_mol.description: Van 't Hoff enthalpy of local partial unfolding to aggregation-competent state U (distinct from global CH2 melting)

dCp_u_kj_mol_k.description: Heat capacity change of local partial unfolding (default 0.0)

k_unfold_relax_per_hour.description: Reverse conformational relaxation rate constant k_-1 (U -> N) for 3-state stiff Radau oracle (k_-1 >> k_agg ensures rapid pre-equilibrium validity)

dG_frag_ref_kj_mol.description: Eyring free energy barrier at 5C for SEC_LMW hinge fragmentation pathway in fraction/hour

ea_frag_kj_mol.description: Arrhenius activation energy for SEC_LMW fragmentation pathway

dG_acidic_ref_kj_mol.description: Eyring free energy barrier at 5C for CEX_ACIDIC Asn-deamidation pathway in fraction/hour

ea_acidic_kj_mol.description: Arrhenius activation energy for CEX_ACIDIC deamidation pathway
